imports.detail: standard library maths/containers, numpy, arcengine only

calls.detail: no file, eval or import-hook calls

load.detail: Ve15() loads and RESET renders a 64x64 frame

win_trace.detail: clears all 7 levels in 190 actions and ends in WIN

determinism.detail: two fresh replays produce identical frames

reset.detail: RESET restores each level exactly, keeps completed levels, and the level is winnable after it

level1_short.detail: the recorded level-1 win takes 13 actions (keyboard/mixed target 12-18)

level1_safe.detail: 0 of 24 random runs of up to 150 actions reached GAME_OVER on level 1

early_death.detail: share of random runs that die within 10 actions: L1 0%, L2 0%, L3 0%, L4 0%, L5 0%, L6 0%, L7 0% (limit 10%; a death is GAME_OVER, or the level put back as entered without RESET: by the engine, or on screen after more than 5 frames)

random_resistance.detail: random runs of 250 actions (retrying after GAME_OVER) that cleared the level: L2 0/40, L3 0/40, L4 0/40, L5 0/40, L6 0/40, L7 0/40

fuzz.detail: 65219 random actions: no exception, every frame valid

frames_per_action.detail: longest action plays 7 frames (warn over 15, fail over 60; the site plays ~30 per second)

visible_response.detail: share of random actions with no visible change, by action: {1: 0.24, 2: 0.2, 3: 0.21, 4: 0.23, 5: 0.2, 6: 0.5}

random.mode: uniform over available actions; clicks split between anywhere, a random on-screen colour, and engine click targets
